channel.title: Pier & Point · Prequel Park (Port sub-area)
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Prequel Park (Port sub-area) (Potrero Power Station), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Prequel Park (Port sub-area): The Port's November 2025 memo describes a lease running through March 2087. That date is the lease's end, not a construction schedule, and is now labelled a legal deadline.
item.description: The Port's November 2025 memo describes a lease running through March 2087. That date is the lease's end, not a construction schedule, and is now labelled a legal deadline. Source: https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2025-11/111825_10a_potrero_power_station_lease_amendment_0.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Prequel Park (Port sub-area): The BCDC permit tracker gives June 19, 2025 as the date the application for non-material amendment 2019.006.02 was received and June 26, 2026 as the date it was issued; the map notes and the site timeline entry had shown June 19, 2025 as the issue date and now show June 26, 2026. The timeline entry for the November 18, 2025 Port Commission vote now cites the meeting minutes instead of a bare domain. The record no longer calls California Barrel Company the property owner (the Port owns this land; the company is its lessee), no longer says Resolution 20-12 'first designates' the Port sub-area for open space, and now names California Barrel Company LLC alongside Fifth Space as publisher of the developer's website.
item.description: The BCDC permit tracker gives June 19, 2025 as the date the application for non-material amendment 2019.006.02 was received and June 26, 2026 as the date it was issued; the map notes and the site timeline entry had shown June 19, 2025 as the issue date and now show June 26, 2026. The timeline entry for the November 18, 2025 Port Commission vote now cites the meeting minutes instead of a bare domain. The record no longer calls California Barrel Company the property owner (the Port owns this land; the company is its lessee), no longer says Resolution 20-12 'first designates' the Port sub-area for open space, and now names California Barrel Company LLC alongside Fifth Space as publisher of the developer's website. Source: San Francisco Bay Conservation and Development Commission, permit application tracker (https://www.bcdc.ca.gov/programs/permits/permit-application-tracker/); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission minutes, 2025-11-18 (https://www.sfport.com/media/10953/download?inline); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission Item 10A memo, 2025-11-14 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2025-11/111825_10a_potrero_power_station_lease_amendment_0.pdf); California Barrel Company LLC, Power Station website (https://dogpatchpowerstation.com/).

item.title: Correction · Prequel Park (Port sub-area): Two figures previously repeated on more than one record now sit once each in the shared site-wide cost list for Potrero, and this record points to both: the $1 a year rent under Port Lease L-16662, which this record shares with the Potrero waterfront park (same lease, same source and date), and the developer's $15-20 million estimate for Prequel Park, which is 'not broken out for the Port portion' and was copied identically onto the Power Station sub-area record.
